deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Prod traffic spike – elevated 500s observed on /v1/generate since 03:29 UTC following rollout v2026-03-15-2. p50/p95 latency up, error-rate ~2.1%. Monitoring: https://metrics.redwood/internal/d/abc123/inference?from=now-15m. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/incident/runbooks/production-5xx

maya (oncall): taking this. paging SRE/eng oncall. assigning incident, will triage live and escalate if rollback needed.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1456 created (sev=P1). Pages: maya (oncall), samir, lina. Slack thread locked to responders.

maya (oncall): quick context: canary at 10% looked fine ~03:20-03:25. full rollout started 03:27 UTC. Errors started climbing ~03:29. Who kicked the rollout?

samir: that was my rollout (samir). We pushed a small change to model-proxy: connection-pool override feature to improve throughput for long sequences. Canary passed in our smoke tests but might be interacting poorly under production traffic patterns.

lina: can we flip the feature-flag kill-switch for model-proxy.pool_size_override? Admin toggle available in Console OR via API. Example curl to flip off: ```bash
curl -X POST \"https://admin.redwood/api/feature-flags/toggle\" \\\n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \\\n -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n -d '{"flag":"model-proxy.pool_size_override","value":false}'
```

maya (oncall): executing toggle now.

deploy-bot: feature-flag update: model-proxy.pool_size_override set to false by maya at 03:32 UTC (via Console API). Hash: a1b2c3.

maya (oncall): initial effect: 500-rate dropped from 2.1% -> 1.3% in 3m but p95 still high. Looks like partial mitigation. I'm triggering rollback to previous stable image (v2026-03-14-stable) to fully remediate.

samir: starting rollback now. Command: ```bash
# helm rollback to previous revision
helm rollback inference-runtime-release 42 --namespace=prod --wait --timeout=10m
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by samir. Kicking pod replacement; 6/6 new stable pods scheduled. Status watch: https://deployments.redwood/internal/status/infra/12345

lina: while rollback proceeds, seeing Redis connection pool warnings in model-proxy logs: `ERROR redis: connection timeout` — could be transient due to pod churn. I'm increasing redis maxclients temporarily and adding a small burst of connections on the cache tier.

rajiv: FYI support queue spike: ~120 tickets in last 10m, users report timeouts + 500s when calling /v1/generate. Estimated impacted requests ~30k in last 10m (~2% of total traffic). Preparing customer-facing note, will push to status.redwood.io if rollback not stabilizing in next 10m.

maya (oncall): rollback progress: 4/6 new pods ready, error-rate trending down to 0.6%. I'm going to hand off ongoing monitoring and RCA ownership to samir (he did the rollout) — I need to hop out for a scheduled calendar block in 8m.

samir: ack taking handoff. I'll watch metrics, logs, and coordinate a postmortem. Next steps: gather timeline, capture heap/dump from failing pods, compare canary vs prod traffic profiles, check model-proxy pool defaults + telemetry.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1456 updated: owner=samir, status=mitigated (rollback in progress). Postmortem assigned.

samir: initial note for postmortem: suspected regression in connection management when pool override engages under high concurrent burst patterns. Will draft RCA and include revert checklist. Will also add an automated smoke test hitting our long-sequence paths to catch this next time.

opsbot: rollback completed. All pods stable. 500-rate back to baseline (~0.02%). Running extended verification for 30m.

samir: thanks all — I'll keep collecting artifacts and will post a preliminary RCA in this thread in ~2h. For now, no customer-facing outage declared; support to keep triage messages routed to incident channel. Handoff official: maya -> samir.

maya (oncall): leaving handoff notes in runbook: https://wiki.redwood/incident/runbooks/production-5xx#handoff. Good luck, team. :slightly_smiling_face:

rajiv: posted a short update to status.redwood.io and pinged top 5 affected customers with a PS (we'll follow up with a fuller post once RCA is ready).

samir: acknowledged. I'll close the active paging once verification window completes.
